review_candidates.title: Engineer - Cyber Platforms
review_candidates.description: The technology space is evolving, and so are we. At Bendigo Bank we are simplifying our technology function, creating clearer accountabilities aligned with our strategy and customer needs. With a focus on delivering innovative services at scale, we’re creating a future-ready customer experience and high-performing culture. As a Cyber Platforms Engineer, you will support the platform backbone of our security operations. While our Cyber Fusion Centre actively hunts and responds to threats, your mission is to help build, maintain, and support the underlying platforms, ingestion pipelines, and API integrations that make their work possible. This role is ideal for a hands-on engineer with a passion for security platforms, cloud infrastructure, and defensive security operations who wants to help keep our capabilities scalable and resilient. In this role you’ll get to… Maintain daily platform health: Monitor and support core cyber platforms (SIEM, SOAR, EDR, Email Security, Information Protection, Cloud Security, and Threat Intelligence) to ensure day-to-day operational stability, reliability, and system health for our Cyber Fusion Centre. Collaborate and learn : Work closely with Senior Engineers and TPOs to understand platform roadmaps, implement technical tasks, and continuously grow your engineering capability. Support infrastructure deployments : Assist in managing infrastructure as code by utilizing Terraform and CI/CD pipelines to configure and operate security tooling across cloud environments (AWS and GCP) under the guidance of senior team members. Manage security agents and telemetry : Troubleshoot, monitor, and maintain the health of security agents (such as EDR) deployed across enterprise endpoints and infrastructure. Support data ingestion: Assist with onboarding and maintaining log ingestion pathways, ensuring a steady, reliable flow of parsed and normalised data for our defensive teams. Automate routine administration: Use scripting and basic automation tools to reduce repetitive manual overhead and improve daily operational efficiency. Learn and apply security standards: Align daily platform configurations with data privacy, PII handling, and usage guidelines to ensure consistent compliance. Proactively develop skills: Actively participate in training, knowledge-sharing sessions, and hands-on learning opportunities to expand your technical and cyber security domain expertise. What you’ll bring to the role To be successful in this role you will have: Foundational experience in Cyber Platform Engineering: Practical exposure to administering, maintaining, and troubleshooting enterprise security tools in a day-to-day operational environment. A growth mindset and proactive learning attitude: A strong, self-driven desire to develop your skills, learn new technologies, and proactively seek feedback and mentorship from Senior Engineers. Collaborative spirit: Excellent communication skills with an eagerness to work in partnership with team members, incident responders, and Technical Product Owners (TPOs) to solve day-to-day platform issues. Cloud exposure: Practical familiarity with public cloud platforms (AWS or GCP), including an interest or basic experience in using Terraform and CI/CD pipelines. Familiarity with log management: Basic understanding of log sources, telemetry routing, and the normalisation or parsing of security logs. Scripting skills: Foundational scripting skills (e.g., Python, Bash, PowerShell) to assist with task automation and interacting with APIs. Additionally, exposure to or interest in the following will be highly regarded: Identity & Access Management: Basic knowledge of integrating applications with modern identity systems like Microsoft Entra ID. Vulnerability & Patch Management: Familiarity with keeping platform infrastructure patched, secure, and up to date. AI Tech: An interest in learning how security infrastructure and data pipelines support emerging AI tools in SecOps. This is a permanent, full-time opportunity , located at our Melbourne or Bendigo Head Office locations. So, why work with us? Want big impact that matters? Here, you’ll know your work directly benefits the customers and communities we all serve. Want to be more than just a number? Join a team that truly values you – and that gets more and more diverse every day. Want career opportunity AND flexibility? Achieve both here, where we know that balance and progression go hand in hand. You’ll also get access to a great range of benefits, including: Hybrid work? Flexible hours? A compressed work week? Our flexible work options are designed to suit your life. We offer flexible work options that put our people first, working in a hybrid model with a minimum local Head Office attendance requirement determined by your Leader, to find a rhythm that works best for you and your team. We believe that coming into the office some of the time is the best way to learn, stay connected and collaborate effectively, especially for key activities like team days, 1:1s, and town halls. Health and well-being support, including discounted gym memberships, private health insurance options, and our Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your immediate family members. Take your learning to the next level through opportunities like our corporate university ‘BEN U’ or at an external provider of your choice. We’re making better, bigger. And we’ll get there with you Could you be our newest team member? Now’s the time to set your sights even higher – on the future you and the future career you deserve. Wij werken in een enterprise-omgeving met producten als Fortinet, Arista, Cisco. In ons datacenter maken we gebruik van SDN (Cisco ACI) en virtualisatie op basis van ProxMox en OpenShift. Ons campusnetwerk migreren we van een HPE Comware MPLS-netwerk naar EVPN/VXLAN-netwerk gebaseerd op Arista-apparatuur. As an Infrastructure Solutions Engineer, this is a hands-on engineering role responsible for designing, automating, validating, and improving infrastructure solutions across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments. The role combines broad enterprise infrastructure knowledge with practical capability in automation, Infrastructure as Code, observability, troubleshooting, resiliency, disaster recovery, and operational readiness. The engineer partners with infrastructure product teams, architects, application teams, reliability engineers, operations, security, and service-management teams to translate business, technical, and non-functional requirements into reusable, version-controlled, documented, and supportable engineering patterns. The role supports the design and validation of high-availability, failover, disaster-recovery, and recovery-testing approaches, including automated recovery validation where appropriate. This position troubleshoots and resolves complex infrastructure issues, performs root-cause and performance analysis, and implements corrective, preventive, and automated remediation. The engineer contributes technical expertise to design reviews, build-readiness reviews, operational-readiness reviews, and production-readiness activities; independently delivers moderately complex technical work; collaborates across teams; and communicates recommendations to technical stakeholders. Senior engineers provide guidance for the most complex or unusual assignments. Applies automation, monitoring, and optimization techniques to ensure high availability and performance of infrastructure. Manages infrastructure engineering projects and processes aligned with organizational policies and regulatory requirements. Collaborates with cross-functional teams and stakeholders to integrate new technologies and continuously improve infrastructure standards and processes. Troubleshoots and resolves complex technical issues impacting infrastructure performance and reliability. Supports compliance with technology strategies, standards, and governance to mitigate risks and ensure regulatory adherence. Reviews and guides infrastructure designs, configurations, and procedures to support operational consistency and knowledge sharing. Provides technical guidance and direction to lower-level technical professionals. Develops technical solutions with deep analysis of infrastructure systems and leads infrastructure processes. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, a related field, or equivalent education, training, and work-related experience. Minimum of 5 years of professional experience in infrastructure engineering. Strong knowledge of enterprise infrastructure technologies including cloud, network, database, storage, platform, computing, and middleware. Preferred Qualifications Hands-on experience in Automation and Infrastructure as Code using Ansible, Ansible Automation Platform, Terraform, Terraform Enterprise, Python, Linux, and Git-based workflows. Experience in Resiliency and Disaster Recovery Engineering, including high-availability patterns, failover design, recovery validation, disaster recovery testing, dependency analysis, operational readiness, and recovery objectives. Hands-on experience with Observability Engineering platforms including Splunk (SPL, dashboards, alerts, and event correlation), Dynatrace, Grafana, Prometheus, ThousandEyes, AppDynamics, or equivalent monitoring technologies. Experience integrating infrastructure engineering with DevOps and CI/CD practices using GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, Harness, GitOps, Argo CD, or comparable delivery platforms. Experience administering or troubleshooting OpenShift and Kubernetes platforms, including cluster operations, networking, storage, container services, and cloud-native technologies. Experience in Incident Engineering, including complex troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, performance analysis, corrective action, and automated remediation. Working knowledge across enterprise infrastructure domains, including compute, Linux and Windows operating systems, virtualization, networking, DNS, load balancing, firewalls, storage, backup and recovery, middleware, messaging, and cloud platforms. Experience working with integration and service-management technologies including ServiceNow, MuleSoft, APIs, IBM MQ, Kafka, or similar enterprise platforms. Experience applying security, compliance, and governance practices, including vulnerability remediation, secrets management, role-based access controls, infrastructure hardening, policy enforcement, and reusable engineering standards within regulated environments. Experience in the financial services industry and certifications related to cloud, infrastructure, automation, platform engineering, reliability engineering, containers, or cybersecurity are preferred. review_candidates.title: Systems Engineer – Defense C2 Integration & Deployment
review_candidates.description: Company Description CS Group Canada, a subsidiary of CS Group (part of the Sopra Steria Group), is a leader in the development and certification of safety-critical systems in the aerospace, electric, and autonomous driving industries. Joining CS Group Canada means taking part in complex, high-tech projects for some of the most prestigious system manufacturers in North America, while benefiting from competitive salaries, comprehensive benefits, and flexible work arrangements. Job Description Would you like to contribute to the development, integration, and operational deployment of advanced defense systems? CS Group Canada is looking for a Systems Engineer – Defense C2 Integration & Deployment to support the design, integration, verification, validation, and deployment of complex defense solutions, including Command & Control (C2), surveillance, and mission-critical systems. You will work on multidisciplinary systems combining software, hardware, sensors, and communication networks, from system engineering and integration through field deployment and operational validation. Your responsibilities: Contribute to the definition and development of system architectures for defense applications, including C2/C4ISR and surveillance systems. Analyze operational needs and translate customer requirements into system-level functional and technical specifications. Support the integration of heterogeneous subsystems, including radars, electro-optical/infrared (EO/IR) sensors, RF detection systems, communication networks, and other mission-critical equipment. Define and manage system interfaces and Interface Control Documents (ICDs) to ensure interoperability between equipment and platforms from different suppliers. Participate in the integration of C2 capabilities, including sensor fusion, target tracking, situational awareness, and operational decision-support functions. Develop and execute system integration, verification, and validation (IV&V) plans, test procedures, and acceptance criteria. Plan and support the deployment, configuration, commissioning, and operational readiness of integrated defense systems at customer sites. Participate in on-site integration, field testing, system demonstrations, and customer acceptance activities. Investigate and resolve technical issues related to system functionality, performance, interfaces, and communications, both in laboratory and operational environments. Collaborate with customers, suppliers, and multidisciplinary engineering teams to ensure successful system integration and deployment. Maintain requirements traceability and contribute to technical documentation, integration reports, and system qualification activities. Participate in technical reviews (SRR, PDR, CDR, TRR) throughout the system development lifecycle. Qualifications University degree in Systems, Electrical, Computer, Software Engineering, or a related field. Relevant experience in systems engineering, integration, and validation of complex defense or mission-critical systems. Good understanding of Command & Control (C2) architectures, surveillance systems, and operational decision-support systems. Experience with the integration of sensors and subsystems, including radar, EO/IR, RF detection, and communication systems. Knowledge of system requirements management, interface definition (ICDs), and integration, verification, and validation (IV&V) processes. Familiarity with sensor fusion, target detection and tracking, and real-time situational awareness. Experience with communication protocols, networking, and interoperability between heterogeneous systems. Experience with system deployment, commissioning, field testing, or operational acceptance activities. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, autonomy, and ability to work within multidisciplinary teams. Willingness to travel to customer sites for system integration, deployment, and testing activities. Ability to obtain the required security clearance for defense-related projects. Additional Information Please note that only selected candidates and Permanent Residents/Canadian Citizens will be contacted. Job Types: Full-time, Permanent CS Group Canada values diversity in the workplace and encourages women, visible minorities, ethnic minorities, aboriginal people, and people with disabilities to apply. Benefits: Hybrid Work Industry leading medical, dental, and vision Insurance Access to a telemedicine service RRSP program Personal and sick days Recreation room with pool table and foosball table All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
